name: Once Upon a Doll Story
source:
Once Upon a Doll Story is the tale of a forgotten doll lost in a spooky attic filled with dark corridors and glowing eyes. Unsure of who she is or what her purpose is this little doll seeks a way out of this dreadful place and seeks a girl called Emily. 

[From [url=https://mifuworks.itch.io/once-upon-a-doll-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Once Upon a Doll Story》讲述一个被遗忘的娃娃的故事。她迷失在阴森的阁楼里，四周尽是黑暗的走廊与发光的眼睛。这个小娃娃不知道自己是谁，也不知道自己为何存在，只想逃离这个可怕的地方，找到一个名叫Emily的女孩。

[摘自[url=https://mifuworks.itch.io/once-upon-a-doll-story]itch.io[/url]]
